author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Radxa has introduced the Cubie A7S, a 51 x 51 mm single board computer built around the Allwinner A733. The compact board combines Cortex-A76 and Cortex-A55 CPU cores with LPDDR5 memory, PCIe 3.0 expansion, and an integrated NPU rated at 3 TOPS, targeting edge AI, vision, and embedded multimedia applications. title: Radxa Cubie A7S Integrates A733 SoC, RISC-V MCU, and LPDDR5 Memory
